area: Squirrel, Urchin, Sparrow and Dolphin Time abilities
summary: Every polished Regatta hull now has a Time pace lever (Garrett 2026-11-17: no lever-free reference). Squirrel Time throttle multiplier switched on (x1.25 at rest -> x1.5 at Time 10); Urchin gets a new Time multiplier on its rail ride (TrailFollower.rideSpeedMultiplier, x0.75 at rest -> x0.9 at Time 10); Sparrow afterburner Max 2.0625->2.25; Dolphin Drift Charge max 3.106->3.3885
why: Knee curve with five levered hulls: pool imbalance card 1.46->1.43, L5 1.36->1.18; every home Time rung (Skein, Skim Race, Breakwater, Switchback I1-I4) inside its bars. Kit change: flagged risky for Garrett's sign-off after the fact.
